# Generated by tools/m10_situation_actions.py --write.
# Two material, AI-usable responses for each active ancient situation.

# Generated ancient-current response. The selector keeps this action inside its own situation panel.
antq_m10_armenian_war_relief = {
	type = situation
	show_message = no
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 6
	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 3
	potential = {
		scope:actor = { tag = XAO }
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = { gold >= 18 }
		scope:recipient = { situation_is_active = yes }
	}
	cooldown = { type = antq_m10_armenian_war_relief years = 2 }
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		interaction_source_list = {
			situation:antq_m10_armenian_war = { add_to_list = source }
		}
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:antq_m10_armenian_war = this
			situation_is_active = yes
			scope:actor = { tag = XAO }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = -18
			add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		}
		scope:recipient = { change_variable = { name = antq_m10_armenian_war_resolution_progress add = 18 } }
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = 10
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold < 36 } } add = -18 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { stability < 0 } } add = 10 }
	}
}

	type = situation
	show_message = no
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 6
	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 3
	potential = {
		scope:actor = { tag = XAH }
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = { gold >= 18 }
		scope:recipient = { situation_is_active = yes }
	}
	cooldown = { type = antq_m10_final_hephthalites_relief years = 2 }
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		interaction_source_list = {
			situation:antq_m10_final_hephthalites = { add_to_list = source }
		}
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:antq_m10_final_hephthalites = this
			situation_is_active = yes
			scope:actor = { tag = XAH }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = -18
			add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		}
		scope:recipient = { change_variable = { name = antq_m10_final_hephthalites_resolution_progress add = 18 } }
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = 10
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold < 36 } } add = -18 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { stability < 0 } } add = 10 }
	}
}
